mainTopic: How strong is the יבום bond (זיקה) for רבי שמעון, and when does a later-born brother's birth forbid the widow?
overview: The amud opens by finishing a proof that רבי שמעון is in doubt about how strong the יבום bond (זיקה) is. Someone suggests that his requirement of חליצה is only a rabbinic גזירה. The גמרא rejects that, because a ברייתא shows רבי שמעון's real reason is a doubt about the second brother's מאמר. אביי then argues that רבי שמעון may hold זיקה ככנוסה when there is one יבם, and be unsure only when there are two. The גמרא tests this split against רבי שמעון's 'rule' about a brother born before or after the יבום, and against רב אושעיא's case of two brothers married to related women. רב עמרם and רבא each try to answer the second challenge, and both answers are rejected. רב אשי then saves the view: the women fell at the very same moment, which רבי שמעון holds is possible, like רבי יוסי הגלילי. Finally, רב פפא limits רבי שמעון's leniency to a case where the יבום came before the brother's birth, and a ברייתא is brought that supports him and refutes רבי אושעיא.

steps.title: רבי שמעון's ruling shows he is in doubt
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא finishes its argument. רבי שמעון does not let one יבום free the other woman, so he must be unsure whether the bond counts as full marriage.
steps.simpleTranslation: [If the bond is like marriage, both women come] from one household. But to do יבום with one and free the other, he may not do that. Perhaps the bond is not like marriage, and then they are two יבמות coming from two households. So clearly, רבי שמעון is in doubt!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is wrapping up a proof that began on the previous amud. It concludes that רבי שמעון is unsure how strong the זיקה bond is.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the זיקה makes the first widow fully the second brother's wife, both women count as wives of one man, the second brother. Then one יבום would free the other, as with any two wives of one brother. Since רבי שמעון still requires חליצה for the second woman, he must be worried that the bond is not that strong. If it is not, she is still the first brother's widow, which makes two separate households.

keyTerms.meaning: The bond of יבום that ties a widow to her late husband's brother
Like a woman who is fully married
Two widows waiting for יבום
From two households, meaning the widows of two different brothers
So clearly; this shows that
He is in doubt about it

steps.confusionAlert: Don't confuse 'one house' and 'two houses.' From one house (one dead brother), one יבום frees the other wife. From two houses (two dead brothers), each widow needs her own יבום or חליצה.

phrases.english: from one household.
phrases.notes: This finishes a sentence from before: if the bond counts as marriage, both women belong to the second brother's household.

phrases.english: To do יבום with one and free the other,
phrases.notes: The letter in square brackets is part of the corrected wording.

phrases.english: he may not, because perhaps
the bond is not like full marriage,
and then they are two יבמות
who come from two households.
So clearly, he is in doubt!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the proof that started on the previous amud
steps.raayaObject: That רבי שמעון is unsure whether זיקה is like full marriage
steps.raayaSupportSource: רבי שמעון's ruling that the third brother does יבום with one woman and חליצה with the other

steps.title: Maybe the חליצה is only a rabbinic safeguard
steps.stepSummary: A suggested way out of the proof: by Torah law one יבום does free the other, and the חכמים required חליצה only so people won't make a mistake in other cases.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if you would say: by Torah law, yes, one is taken in יבום and the other is freed. It is only forbidden by the חכמים, as a גזירה, so people won't say that whenever two יבמות come from two households, one is taken in יבום and the other is freed with nothing at all.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא raises a possible way to push away the proof. Maybe רבי שמעון is not in doubt at all, and the חליצה is just a rabbinic precaution.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This suggestion treats the bond as fully like marriage, so by Torah law the two women really are from one household. The extra חליצה would then be only a דרבנן safeguard. Onlookers might not know about the מאמר and would see what looks like widows from two brothers, one freeing the other. If that were true, the ruling would not prove any doubt.

keyTerms.meaning: And if you would say; introduces a possible objection
By Torah law
By rabbinic law
A rabbinic decree made to prevent a mistake
Lest people say (and come to a mistake)
With nothing at all, meaning without יבום or חליצה

phrases.english: And if you would say: by Torah law
yes, one is taken in יבום
and the other one is freed,
and it is only forbidden by the חכמים,
as a decree, so people won't say
that with two יבמות who come from two households,
one is taken in יבום and the other is freed
with nothing at all,

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Offers a way to push away the proof of step 1
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The proof that רבי שמעון is in doubt
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The חליצה might come from a rabbinic גזירה and not from a real doubt

steps.title: No, his reason is a real doubt about the מאמר
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא rejects the rabbinic-safeguard idea. רבי שמעון's own reason is a doubt: does the מאמר work as a real מאמר or not?
steps.simpleTranslation: But רבי שמעון's reason is because of 'is it a מאמר, or is it not a מאמר.'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes back against the suggestion in step 2. It says we already know רבי שמעון's real reason, and it is not a rabbinic safeguard.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי שמעון does not say anything about a גזירה. His stated reason is a true doubt about whether the second brother's מאמר had full force. So the doubt from step 1 stands, and the proof is restored. The next step quotes the source for this.

keyTerms.meaning: But look; introduces a fact that disproves what was just said
The reason
A betrothal done by the יבם before the full יבום

phrases.english: But רבי שמעון's reason
is because of 'it is a מאמר, or it is not a מאמר.'

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the suggestion of step 2
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The idea that the חליצה is only a rabbinic גזירה
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: רבי שמעון himself gives a different reason, a real doubt about the מאמר

steps.title: The ברייתא where רבי שמעון explains himself
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא shows רבי שמעון arguing from both sides of the doubt about the second brother's מאמר.
steps.simpleTranslation: As it was taught: רבי שמעון said to the חכמים: If the second brother's מאמר is a real מאמר, the third brother is living with the second brother's wife. And if the second brother's מאמר is not a real מאמר, he is living with the first brother's wife.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings the source showing what רבי שמעון's reason really is. He sets out both possibilities about the מאמר.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the מאמר works fully, the widow became the second brother's wife, so the third brother is taking her as the second brother's widow. If it doesn't work, she is still only the first brother's widow. Since רבי שמעון speaks in terms of 'if it is, if it isn't,' his ruling rests on a real doubt about the מאמר, not on a rabbinic safeguard.

keyTerms.meaning: The wife of the second brother
The wife of the first brother
He lives with her as a husband

steps.whatToRemember: רבי שמעון's ruling (יבום for one, חליצה for the other) comes from a real doubt: does the מאמר make the widow fully the second brother's wife or not? It is not just a rabbinic safeguard.

phrases.english: As it was taught:
רבי שמעון said to the חכמים:
If the second brother's מאמר is a real מאמר,
he is living with the second brother's wife.
phrases.notes: 'He' is the third brother, the one now doing יבום.

phrases.aramaic: וְאִם מַאֲמָרוֹ שֶׁל שֵׁנִי אֵינוֹ מַאֲמָר
phrases.english: And if the second brother's מאמר is not a real מאמר,
he is living with the first brother's wife.

steps.triggerLanguage: דְּתַנְיָא, אָמַר לָהֶם רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן לַחֲכָמִים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the source for the claim in step 3
steps.raayaObject: That רבי שמעון's reason is a doubt about whether the מאמר is a real מאמר
steps.raayaSupportSource: A ברייתא where רבי שמעון argues with the חכמים

steps.title: אביי splits one brother-in-law from two
steps.stepSummary: אביי says the earlier proof does not work. רבי שמעון may hold that זיקה is like marriage with one יבם, and is unsure only when there are two יבמים.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי said to him: Don't you see a difference between a bond to one יבם and a bond to two יבמים? Maybe when רבי שמעון said a bond is like marriage, he meant with one יבם. With two יבמים, no.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי is knocking down the earlier proof about רבי שמעון. He offers a middle position the proof never considered.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The earlier steps showed that רבי שמעון is unsure whether זיקה counts as marriage. אביי says that doubt may exist only when the widow is tied to two brothers at once, because then the bond is split between them. With a single יבם, the bond is complete, so רבי שמעון might hold זיקה ככנוסה דמיא.

keyTerms.meaning: The bond tying a childless widow to her late husband's brother
She is treated as if already married to him
A single surviving brother-in-law
Two surviving brothers-in-law

phrases.english: Abaye said to him:
phrases.notes: "Him" is the one who brought the proof that רבי שמעון is unsure.

phrases.english: And is there no difference to you
between the bond to a single yavam
and the bond to two yevamim?
Perhaps when Rabbi Shimon said
that the bond is like she is married,
that is with a single yavam,
but with two yevamin, no.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲמַר לֵיהּ אַבָּיֵי: וְלָא שָׁנֵי לָךְ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the conclusion drawn from steps 1–4 by limiting רבי שמעון's doubt to the two-יבם case.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The claim that רבי שמעון is unsure about זיקה in every case
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The proof came from a case with two יבמים, so it says nothing about a single יבם.

steps.title: A ברייתא with רבי שמעון's general rule
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks whether רבי שמעון really makes this split. It brings his rule about a brother born after his brother died.
steps.simpleTranslation: Does רבי שמעון really make this split? But a ברייתא teaches: רבי שמעון stated a rule. Whenever the birth comes before the marriage, she does not do חליצה and does not do יבום. If the marriage comes before the birth, she either does חליצה or יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges אביי by quoting a ברייתא. Here it only sets out the source; the next step shows why it hurts אביי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The case: one brother dies, and a second brother marries the widow through יבום. A third brother is born, and then the second brother dies. If the third brother was born before the יבום marriage, רבי שמעון forbids her to him. If the marriage happened first, he permits her.

keyTerms.meaning: A general rule
Birth (here, of the younger brother)
The full marriage through יבום
She does חליצה, the release ceremony
She marries the brother through יבום

phrases.english: And does Rabbi Shimon make a difference?
But it is taught in a baraita:
Rabbi Shimon stated a principle:
Whenever the birth comes before the marriage,
phrases.notes: The birth of the third brother, before the second brother married the widow through יבום.

phrases.english: she does not do חליצה and does not do יבום,
if the marriage came before the birth,
phrases.notes: The round-bracket word is in the printed text; the square-bracket word is the corrected wording. Both mean "came before."

phrases.english: she either does חליצה or does יבום.

steps.triggerLanguage: וּמִי שָׁנֵי לֵיהּ לְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן? וְהָתַנְיָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks אביי's split by bringing a ברייתא of רבי שמעון.
steps.kashyaTarget: אביי's claim that רבי שמעון treats one יבם differently from two
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רבי שמעון's rule about birth before marriage suggests he does not treat זיקה as marriage, apparently even with one יבם.

steps.title: The ברייתא seems to be about one יבם
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא argues the ברייתא is about a single יבם. Even so, רבי שמעון forbids her, so זיקה is not like marriage even then.
steps.simpleTranslation: Isn't it talking about a single יבם? And still it teaches that she does not do חליצה and does not do יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא now spells out how the ברייתא works against אביי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If זיקה were like marriage with one יבם, the widow would count as the second brother's wife from the moment the first brother died. That would be before the third brother was born, so she should be permitted to him. Since רבי שמעון forbids her, it seems זיקה is not like marriage even with a single יבם.

keyTerms.meaning: Isn't it? (opens a suggested reading of a source)
And yet it teaches

phrases.english: Is it not about a single yavam,
and it teaches:
she does not do חליצה and does not do יבום.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains how the ברייתא in step 6 hits אביי.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Reading the ברייתא as a one-יבם case shows זיקה is not like marriage even with one יבם.

steps.title: The ברייתא is about two יבמים
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that the ברייתא is about two יבמים, so it fits אביי's split.
steps.simpleTranslation: No, it is talking about two יבמים.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא defends אביי. It reads the ברייתא as a case with more than one brother to whom the widow was tied.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If there were two יבמים, then by אביי's view the bond is weaker and is not like marriage. So the widow is forbidden to the brother born later, exactly as the ברייתא says. The ברייתא no longer contradicts אביי.

keyTerms.meaning: No (rejects the suggested reading)

phrases.english: No, it is about two yevamim.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 7 by setting the ברייתא in a two-יבם case.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ברייתא is about one יבם, which disproves אביי.
steps.terutzMaskana: The ברייתא is about two יבמים, which matches אביי.

steps.title: So with one יבם she would be permitted?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what follows from that answer: with one יבם, she could do חליצה or יבום.
steps.simpleTranslation: But with a single יבם, what? Would she then either do חליצה or יבום?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא draws out what the last answer implies. This sets up the next challenge.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the ברייתא is limited to two יבמים, then with one יבם the bond counts as marriage. In that case the widow would be permitted to the brother born later, even if he was born before the יבום marriage.

keyTerms.meaning: So too, likewise

phrases.english: But with a single yavam, what?

phrases.aramaic: הָכִי נָמֵי אוֹ חוֹלֶצֶת אוֹ מִתְיַיבֶּמֶת?
phrases.english: So too, she either does חליצה or does יבום?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Spells out what the answer in step 8 means for the one-יבם case.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What the law would be with a single יבם if the ברייתא is about two

steps.title: Then רבי שמעון should have spelled out the split
steps.stepSummary: If one יבם made a difference, רבי שמעון should have made the split inside the birth-first case instead of only contrasting it with marriage-first.
steps.simpleTranslation: If so, instead of teaching that when the marriage comes before the birth she does חליצה or יבום, he should have split the case itself and taught: When is this said? With two יבמים. But with one יבם, she either does חליצה or יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks the answer from step 8. It argues that the way רבי שמעון worded his rule does not fit it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the one-יבם case were permitted, that would be a clear and important exception inside the birth-first case. A rule-maker would naturally say "this applies only to two יבמים" instead of jumping to the marriage-first case. Since רבי שמעון did not, it seems he forbids her even with one יבם.

keyTerms.meaning: If so
Instead of teaching
Let him split and teach within the same case
When is this said? (a limiting phrase)

steps.whatToRemember: אביי suggested that רבי שמעון treats זיקה as marriage with one יבם and is unsure only with two. The גמרא answered the ברייתא challenge by setting it in a two-יבם case. Now it presses back: the ברייתא's wording suggests no such split.

phrases.english: If so, instead of teaching:
if the marriage came before the birth,
she either does חליצה or does יבום,
let him split and teach within the same case:
phrases.notes: He means inside the birth-first case itself.

phrases.english: When is this said? With two yevamim,
but with a single yavam,
she either does חליצה or does יבום.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the answer in step 8 based on how the ברייתא is worded.
steps.kashyaTarget: The reading of the ברייתא as a two-יבם case
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If one יבם were treated differently, the ברייתא would have stated that split directly inside the birth-first case.

steps.title: The whole ברייתא is about two יבמים
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers step 10: both cases in the ברייתא involve two יבמים, so רבי שמעון had no reason to split the birth-first case.
steps.simpleTranslation: The entire ברייתא is talking about a case of two יבמים.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question from step 10. It says every case in the ברייתא has two יבמים, so the one-יבם case never comes up there.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 10 asked why רבי שמעון did not split the birth-first case into one יבם versus two. The answer is that the ברייתא only deals with two יבמים. The contrast is only between birth-first and marriage-first, so there was nothing else to split.

keyTerms.meaning: the whole of it (the entire ברייתא)
it is talking about
two brothers-in-law who could do יבום

phrases.english: The entire [ברייתא] is talking about two יבמים.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קשיא of step 10.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Redefining the case: the whole ברייתא is about two יבמים.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ברייתא includes a one-יבם case, so רבי שמעון should have split it.
steps.terutzMaskana: Both halves of the ברייתא are two-יבם cases, so no split was needed.

steps.title: Then why call it a 'rule'?
steps.stepSummary: If the ברייתא is only about two יבמים, the word 'rule' (כללא) used in it no longer fits.
steps.simpleTranslation: But if so, what is the 'rule' that is being stated?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes back on the answer from step 11. The ברייתא uses the word 'rule', and a rule is supposed to cover every case.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A 'rule' sounds like a general statement for all cases. If the law changes when there is only one יבם, the statement is not general at all. So calling it a 'rule' becomes hard to understand.

keyTerms.meaning: a general rule
but then what...?

phrases.english: But then, what is the 'rule'?!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the תירוץ of step 11.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that the whole ברייתא is about two יבמים.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The word 'rule' suggests one law for all cases. That clashes with a law that changes when there is only one יבם.

steps.title: רב אושעיא brings the case of three brothers
steps.stepSummary: רב אושעיא quotes a משנה: two brothers married to closely related women die, and רבי שמעון exempts the women.
steps.simpleTranslation: And more: רב אושעיא challenged. Three brothers, two of them married to two sisters, or to a woman and her daughter, or a woman and her daughter's daughter, or a woman and her son's daughter. These women do חליצה and not יבום. And רבי שמעון exempts them.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא adds a second challenge to אביי. Here it only quotes the source, and the next step will show why this source is a problem.
steps.deeperAnalysis: After the two married brothers die, only the third brother is left, so there is just one יבם. Each woman is forbidden to him as the relative of the other. The חכמים say both do חליצה, and רבי שמעון says they are exempt even from that.

keyTerms.meaning: and moreover (an additional challenge)
they do חליצה
they do יבום
exempts

phrases.english: And moreover, רב אושעיא raised a challenge:

phrases.aramaic: שְׁלֹשָׁה אַחִין, שְׁנַיִם מֵהֶן נְשׂוּאִין שְׁתֵּי אֲחָיוֹת,
phrases.english: Three brothers, two of whom were married to two sisters,
or to a woman and her daughter,
or to a woman and her daughter's daughter,
or to a woman and her son's daughter —
these women do חליצה and do not do יבום.
And רבי שמעון exempts [them].

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds a second, independent challenge against אביי's split.
steps.kashyaTarget: אביי's claim that רבי שמעון holds זיקה ככנוסה when there is one יבם.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: This is a one-יבם case, and רבי שמעון exempts the women. The next step explains why that contradicts אביי.

steps.title: If זיקה is like marriage, the first widow should do יבום
steps.stepSummary: If רבי שמעון held זיקה ככנוסה, the first widow would already count as the third brother's wife. Then he could marry her, and only the second would be exempt.
steps.simpleTranslation: If you think רבי שמעון holds that זיקה is like a married woman, let him do יבום with the first one, and let the other be exempt!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא now spells out the challenge from רב אושעיא's source. With one יבם, אביי's view leads to a different result than what רבי שמעון actually says.
steps.deeperAnalysis: When the first brother dies, his widow is tied to the third brother by זיקה. If זיקה counts like marriage, she is already like his wife. Then when the second brother dies, the second widow is his 'wife's' sister and is simply exempt, while the first one can do יבום. But רבי שמעון just says 'exempt', which does not match this.

keyTerms.meaning: and if you think that...
the זיקה bond counts like marriage
the first one
the other one

steps.confusionAlert: 'The first' means the widow whose husband died first. She is not the older sister or the first one named in the list.

phrases.english: And if it enters your mind

phrases.aramaic: קָסָבַר רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן זִיקָה כִּכְנוּסָה דָּמְיָא —
phrases.english: that רבי שמעון holds זיקה is like a married woman —
let him do יבום with the first,
phrases.notes: 'The first' means the widow whose husband died first, so her זיקה started first.

phrases.english: and let the other be exempt!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאִי סָלְקָא דַעְתָּךְ קָסָבַר רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן זִיקָה כִּכְנוּסָה דָּמְיָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains why the source quoted in step 13 is a challenge.
steps.kashyaTarget: אביי's view that with one יבם, רבי שמעון holds זיקה ככנוסה.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If זיקה is like marriage, the first widow is already 'his wife' and can do יבום, and only the second is exempt. רבי שמעון's plain 'exempt' does not fit this.

steps.title: רב עמרם: רבי שמעון only exempts the second
steps.stepSummary: רב עמרם reads רבי שמעון's 'exempt' as referring only to the second widow, which fits זיקה ככנוסה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב עמרם said: What does 'exempt' really mean? He exempts the second one.
steps.whatsHappening: רב עמרם defends אביי. He says רבי שמעון's word 'exempt' was only about the second widow.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If 'exempt' means only the second widow, then the first one can do יבום. That is exactly what זיקה ככנוסה predicts. So according to this reading, the משנה fits אביי.

keyTerms.meaning: the second one
what (does it mean)?

phrases.english: רב עמרם said:
What [is meant by] 'exempt'? He exempts the second one.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קשיא of step 14.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Rereading the source: 'exempt' refers only to the second widow.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: רבי שמעון exempts both widows, which goes against זיקה ככנוסה.
steps.terutzMaskana: רבי שמעון exempts only the second, so the first can do יבום, just as זיקה ככנוסה says.

steps.title: A ברייתא says רבי שמעון exempts both
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא states that רבי שמעון exempts both women, so רב עמרם's reading fails and the challenge to אביי stands.
steps.simpleTranslation: But it was taught in a ברייתא: רבי שמעון exempts both of them!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא rejects רב עמרם's answer with a ברייתא that clearly says both women are exempt.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If both are exempt, the first widow was never treated as the יבם's wife. That means רבי שמעון does not hold זיקה ככנוסה even with one יבם. This goes against אביי's split.

keyTerms.meaning: both of them

steps.whatToRemember: At this point the challenge seems to win. In רב אושעיא's case there is only one יבם, yet רבי שמעון exempts both women, which looks like זיקה is not like marriage even with one יבם. רב אשי answers this in step 20.

phrases.english: But it was taught [in a ברייתא]:
רבי שמעון exempts both of them!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects רב עמרם's answer from step 15.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: רב עמרם's reading that 'exempt' means only the second widow.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: An explicit ברייתא says רבי שמעון exempts both, so the first widow is not treated as already married to the יבם.

steps.title: רבא reads 'both' as two different pairs
steps.stepSummary: רבא explains that 'both' means the second woman of one pair and the second woman of another pair.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבא said: When the ברייתא says 'both,' it means the second woman in this pair and the second woman in that pair.
steps.whatsHappening: רבא tries to save the view that רבי שמעון holds זיקה ככנוסה. He says the 'both' in the ברייתא refers to two different second women, not to the two women of a single pair.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ברייתא said רבי שמעון exempts 'both,' which seemed to mean both women of one pair. רבא pictures several pairs of related women. In each pair the first woman becomes bound to the יבם, and the second woman is exempt as her relative. So 'both' really means two 'second' women, and זיקה ככנוסה still works.

keyTerms.meaning: The second one (here, the second woman of a pair)
A pair (here, a pair of closely related women)

phrases.english: Rava said:
The second one in this pair,
and the second one in that pair.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רָבָא: שְׁנִיָּה שֶׁבְּזוּג זֶה, וְהַשְּׁנִיָּה שֶׁבְּזוּג זֶה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the ברייתא from step 16 by reinterpreting the word 'both.'
steps.terutzResolutionType: Reinterpretation of the ברייתא's wording ('both' means two different second women)
steps.terutzHavaAmina: 'Both' means both women of one pair, so the first one is not treated as already married to the יבם.
steps.terutzMaskana: 'Both' means the second woman of each of two pairs, so זיקה ככנוסה can still hold.

steps.title: רבא misread the case as four pairs
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא says רבא was mistaken. The משנה's 'or... or' shows the cases are separate, and with four pairs the ברייתא would have said 'all four.'
steps.simpleTranslation: רבא was mistaken about four pairs. First, the משנה says 'or... or.' Also, if so, the ברייתא should have said 'רבי שמעון exempts all four of them.'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא rejects רבא's answer. It gives two proofs that he misunderstood the case.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבא thought one יבם was facing four pairs of related women at once. But the משנה lists the pairs with 'or... or,' so each is a separate case with only one pair. And if there really were four pairs, the second women would number four, so the ברייתא should have said 'all four,' not 'both.'

keyTerms.meaning: He is mistaken
'Or... or': each case is listed on its own
He should have said

phrases.english: Rava is mistaken about four pairs:
phrases.notes: He read the משנה as if all four pairs fell before one brother together.

phrases.english: One, it teaches "or," "or."
phrases.notes: 'Or' means each pair is its own separate case, not all at once.

phrases.english: And further, "Rabbi Shimon exempts all four of them"
is what it should have said.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects רבא's reading from step 17.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: רבא's whole picture of the case (four pairs before one יבם)
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The משנה's 'or... or' shows separate cases, and four pairs would require the word 'all four,' not 'both.'

steps.title: A ברייתא says neither sister may be taken
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא based on a פסוק says רבי שמעון exempts both women, because once they would become rivals, not even one of them may be taken.
steps.simpleTranslation: And further, a ברייתא teaches: רבי שמעון exempts both of them from חליצה and from יבום, as it says, 'And a woman to her sister you shall not take, to be a rival.' At the moment they would become rivals to each other, you may not take even one of them.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings another ברייתא that rules out רבא's reading completely. It says clearly that neither woman can do יבום.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבא's answer needs the first woman of each pair to be available for יבום. This ברייתא says 'not even one of them' may be taken, and it bases this on the פסוק about sisters as rivals. So both women of the same pair are exempt, and the challenge against זיקה ככנוסה comes back.

keyTerms.meaning: The ceremony that frees a widow from יבום
Marriage of a childless widow to her late husband's brother
To make her a rival (a co-wife)
Rival wives married to the same man
Taking, meaning marriage

phrases.english: And further, it was taught:
Rabbi Shimon exempts both of them
from chalitza and from yibum,
as it is said:
"And a woman to her sister you shall not take, to be a rival,"
at the time they become rivals to one another,
you shall not have any taking,
even of one of them!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְעוֹד תַּנְיָא: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן פּוֹטֵר בִּשְׁתֵּיהֶן מִן הַחֲלִיצָה וּמִן הַיִּיבּוּם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds a further and stronger rejection of רבא's answer.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: רבא's answer entirely, and with it the attempt to keep the first woman available
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The ברייתא explicitly says not even one of the two women may be taken, so 'both' cannot mean only the second women.

steps.title: רב אשי: the women fell at the very same moment
steps.stepSummary: רב אשי says that one after the other, the first would indeed exempt the second. But here both fell at once, and רבי שמעון holds like רבי יוסי הגלילי that exact timing is possible.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, רב אשי said: If they fell one after the other, that is indeed so. Here we are dealing with a case where they fell at the same time. And רבי שמעון holds like רבי יוסי הגלילי, who said it is possible to be exact.
steps.whatsHappening: רב אשי gives a new answer that saves אביי's view that רבי שמעון holds זיקה ככנוסה. He explains that the ברייתא is talking about a special case where both women fell to the יבם at the exact same moment.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With זיקה ככנוסה, whoever falls first is treated like the יבם's wife, so her relative is exempt. But if both brothers died at the very same instant, neither woman came first, so neither can be taken and both are exempt. This only works because רבי שמעון agrees with רבי יוסי הגלילי that two events can truly happen at exactly the same moment.

keyTerms.meaning: One after the other
At the same time
What case are we dealing with here?
It is possible to be exact (two things can happen at precisely the same moment)

steps.whatToRemember: רבי שמעון does hold זיקה ככנוסה: when the women fall one after another, the first exempts the second. He exempts both only when they fall at the exact same moment, which is possible according to רבי יוסי הגלילי's view that one can be exact.
steps.confusionAlert: רב אשי does not say רבי שמעון rejects זיקה ככנוסה. He keeps it, and limits 'both are exempt' to the rare case where both fell at once.
steps.whyThisMatters: This answer removes the challenge against אביי by narrowing the ברייתא to a special case instead of changing רבי שמעון's basic view.

phrases.english: Rather, Rav Ashi said:
If they fell one after the other,
indeed it is so,
phrases.notes: He means the first one would count as the יבם's wife, so the second would be exempt.

phrases.english: here, what are we dealing with?
That they fell at the same time,
phrases.notes: Both brothers died at the exact same moment.

phrases.english: and Rabbi Shimon holds
like Rabbi Yosei HaGelili, who said:
It is possible to be exact.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֶלָּא אָמַר רַב אָשֵׁי: אִי דִּנְפוּל בְּזֶה אַחַר זֶה — הָכִי נָמֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After רבא's answer fails, gives a new way to answer the ברייתא's ruling that both are exempt.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limiting the case (אוקימתא) to both women falling at once, plus linking to רבי יוסי הגלילי's view
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Because רבי שמעון exempts both women, he must not hold זיקה ככנוסה.
steps.terutzMaskana: רבי שמעון holds זיקה ככנוסה. Both women are exempt only because they fell at the exact same moment, which he holds is possible.

steps.title: רב פפא limits רבי שמעון's leniency to a brother born after the יבום
steps.stepSummary: רב פפא says רבי שמעון argues only when the יבום came first and the brother was born later. If the brother was born first, רבי שמעון agrees.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב פפא said: If he did יבום and only afterward the new brother was born, רבי שמעון disagrees with the רבנן. If the brother was born first and afterward he did יבום, רבי שמעון does not disagree.
steps.whatsHappening: רב פפא gives a different view from רבי אושעיא about when רבי שמעון is lenient. The question is when the new brother was born compared to the יבום.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי אושעיא said רבי שמעון is lenient even when the brother was born before the יבום. רב פפא says no. רבי שמעון is lenient only when the יבום had already happened before the birth, and if the birth came first, he agrees with the רבנן that she is forbidden.

keyTerms.meaning: He did יבום, marrying his brother's childless widow
Was born; here, the new younger brother
Disagrees
And afterward; this tells you the order of events

steps.confusionAlert: Watch the order of the words. 'יבם then נולד' is where רבי שמעון disagrees. 'נולד then יבם' is where he agrees with the רבנן.
steps.whyThisMatters: This sets up the whole debate that follows: does רבי שמעון's leniency need the יבום to come before the birth?

phrases.english: Rav Pappa said:
Where he performed levirate marriage and afterward the brother was born —
Rabbi Shimon disagrees;
where the brother was born and afterward he performed levirate marriage —
he does not disagree.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Offers a different explanation from רבי אושעיא's view of רבי שמעון, which the earlier discussion was built on.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רבי שמעון is lenient only when the יבום came before the brother's birth. If the birth came first, he agrees she is forbidden.

steps.title: Both משניות follow the רבנן, in a 'not only this, but also that' style
steps.stepSummary: רב פפא answers why two משניות seem to repeat each other. Both follow the רבנן, and the second one adds a bigger case.
steps.simpleTranslation: And both משניות were needed for the view of the רבנן. The תנא is teaching in the style of 'not only this, but also that.'
steps.whatsHappening: רב פפא deals with רבי אושעיא's question of why two משניות seem to teach the same ruling. He says both follow the רבנן, so there is no need to find a separate argument with רבי שמעון.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי אושעיא used the extra משנה to show a further point in רבי שמעון's view. רב פפא says the משנה simply teaches the obvious case first and then a bigger case. The repetition is just a teaching style, so it proves nothing about רבי שמעון.

keyTerms.meaning: Both of them
Was needed
Not only this, but also that: first teach the simple case, then the bigger one
He (the תנא) teaches

phrases.english: And both were necessary for the Rabbis,
phrases.notes: 'Both' means the two משניות that רבי אושעיא said were repeating each other.

phrases.english: and he teaches in the style of 'not only this, but also that.'

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes רב פפא's approach by dealing with the repeated-משנה question that had pushed רבי אושעיא to his reading.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Style explanation: the repetition is a 'not only this, but also that' teaching pattern.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The second משנה would have been unneeded unless it pointed to a further view of רבי שמעון.
steps.terutzMaskana: Both משניות follow the רבנן. One teaches the simple case and the other the bigger case, so nothing extra is learned about רבי שמעון.

steps.title: A ברייתא supports רב פפא: the brother is born before the מאמר
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא is brought that supports רב פפא and refutes רבי אושעיא. Its first case: the brother was born before any מאמר was done.
steps.simpleTranslation: A ברייתא was taught that fits רב פפא and refutes רבי אושעיא. There were two brothers alive together, and one died without children. The second brother got ready to make a מאמר with the widow, but before he could, a new brother was born, and then the second brother died. The first widow goes free, because she was the wife of a brother who was never alive together with the new brother. The second widow may either do חליצה or יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא to support רב פפא, and it says outright that this ברייתא refutes רבי אושעיא. This step gives the ברייתא's first case.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Here the new brother was born before anything was done with the first widow, so she is forbidden to him as אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו. This fits רב פפא: when the birth comes first, she is forbidden. The second widow was never tied to the first one, so she is a normal יבמה with both choices open.

keyTerms.meaning: A ברייתא was taught that agrees with him
A refutation of an אמורא's view
A first, rabbinic-level betrothal of a יבמה, done before full יבום
The wife of a brother who was never alive at the same time as him
Does חליצה

phrases.english: It is taught in accordance with Rav Pappa,
and this is a refutation of Rabbi Oshaya.
Two brothers alive at the same time,
and one of them died without children,
and this second one got up
to perform levirate betrothal with his yevama,
but did not manage to perform levirate betrothal with her
before a brother was born to him, and then he died —
the first goes out,
phrases.notes: She goes free with no חליצה and no יבום from the new brother.

phrases.aramaic: מִשּׁוּם אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה בְּעוֹלָמוֹ,
phrases.english: because she is the wife of his brother who did not coexist with him,
and the second either performs ḥalitza or enters levirate marriage.

steps.triggerLanguage: תַּנְיָא כְּווֹתֵיהּ דְּרַב פָּפָּא, וּתְיוּבְתָּא דְּרַבִּי אוֹשַׁעְיָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings a ברייתא to support רב פפא's limit on רבי שמעון's leniency.
steps.raayaObject: רב פפא's view that when the brother is born before the יבום, the widow is forbidden as אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו. This is against רבי אושעיא.
steps.raayaSupportSource: A ברייתא about two brothers, where a third is born before a מאמר is done.

steps.title: The ברייתא continues: a מאמר done before or after the birth
steps.stepSummary: If a מאמר was done, whether before or after the brother's birth, the first widow goes free, and the second widow may only do חליצה.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he made a מאמר with her and afterward a brother was born, or a brother was born and afterward he made a מאמר, and then he died: the first widow goes free, because she was the wife of a brother who was never alive together with the new brother. The second widow does חליצה but may not do יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא goes on to its second case, where the second brother did make a מאמר. It gives the same ruling whether the מאמר came before the birth or after it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Because of the מאמר, the first widow is now partly tied to the second brother's house. So the second widow is treated as connected to a forbidden woman, and she may do only חליצה, not יבום. The first widow still goes free as forbidden to the new brother, and the ברייתא treats both orders the same because only a מאמר was done, not full יבום.

keyTerms.meaning: He made a מאמר with her
Enters into יבום
But does not enter into יבום

steps.whatToRemember: רב פפא: רבי שמעון is lenient only when full יבום came before the brother's birth. The ברייתא shows that when the birth comes before any full יבום, the first widow goes free as אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו. After a מאמר, the second widow may do only חליצה.
steps.confusionAlert: A מאמר is not full יבום. That is why the ברייתא treats 'מאמר then birth' the same as 'birth then מאמר.'

phrases.aramaic: עָשָׂה בָּהּ מַאֲמָר, וְאַחַר כָּךְ נוֹלַד אָח,
phrases.english: If he performed levirate betrothal with her, and afterward a brother was born,
or if a brother was born to him

phrases.aramaic: וְאַחַר כָּךְ עָשָׂה בָּהּ מַאֲמָר, וּמֵת —
phrases.english: and afterward he performed levirate betrothal with her, and then he died —
the first goes out

phrases.aramaic: מִשּׁוּם אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה בְּעוֹלָמוֹ,
phrases.english: because she is the wife of his brother who did not coexist with him,
and the second performs ḥalitza and does not enter levirate marriage.

steps.triggerLanguage: עָשָׂה בָּהּ מַאֲמָר, וְאַחַר כָּךְ נוֹלַד אָח
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the same ברייתא with its second case, where a מאמר was done.
steps.raayaObject: רב פפא's view that a widow is forbidden when the brother is born before any full יבום.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The second half of the same ברייתא, about a מאמר done before or after the birth.
